Summary:
This role is ideal for engineering students in their penultimate year, who are required to complete a Vocational Placement as part of their degree. 
In this role, the student observes engineering activities and prepares rudimentary engineering calculations, entering structural models in analysis software and assisting senior engineering staff with structural design, sketches, site inspections and basic engineering reports or dilapidation surveys.
Upon completion of placement, there is potential for the student to continue in an undergraduate role for the remainder of their degree.
Length of placement: 60 days (approx. 12 weeks)
